problems: Before the 2014-15 roster and for 2021-22, UVA pages list names without PGY, so those PGYs are inferred (marked in context). 2016-17 is incomplete (no PGY-1 group). NIH-track residents (program 14; marked '(NIH)', though Ampie 2017 and Asuzu Aug 2018 were not) were excluded by name: Weintraub, Mehta, Ho, Ksendzovsky, Maggio, Mastorakos, Pomeraniec, Ampie, Asuzu, Diamond, Laws. Weintraub appears on UVA lists from Jul 2010 and is treated as NIH, as in program 14. Koga was still marked co-chief in Sep 2012 (a half-updated list); he is recorded as PGY-7 2011-12 and his graduation year (2012) is uncertain. Khaled's entry year is unknown; the adjudicator placed him as '2011 ?', and he is not counted in residents_2011plus. The alumni page gives no years, so the training_history grad years (36 rows) come from the PGY-7 roster year. Common Crawl: 2016 (9 crawls) and 2021-2022 (15 crawls) completed with no failures. Phase 2: Khaled is no longer 'class unknown'; his UVA PGYs are inferred from his Wayne State PGY-7 (2014-15), giving entry 2008. The destination row for Khaled at program 125 (start 2013) sets his entry year to 2013 in Wayne State's adjudication. 22_export_sources.py with no arguments crashes (program_id None); it was run with --program-id 113.
